QUOTE: "**All server handlers.** Every in-tree and product handler calls `this.batchRecords` or `this.handleRecords`." and "`ServerDataOperatorBase`... BaseDataOperator ... + AgentsHandler, ..."

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer says handlers go through `batchRecords` in `BaseDataOperator`. It never says each mixin is constrained to extend `ServerDataOperatorBase`, which is the item's reason. It also notes playbook local actions bypass `batchRecords`, so it does not conclude that every write goes through it.
